places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Wilbarger rides in seeking horses past Augustus's elaborate livery sign; Dish finds Lorena now taken with Jake at the Dry Bean and drinks heavily.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; travellers approach from the east along a road past the Hat Creek corrals

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Call lopes the mare about twenty miles along it; heartsick Dish sits by it for an hour watching a coyote.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Call announces a night raid there; Newt hopes to be taken along; the raider Cortinas is a hero south of the river.

places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Wilbarger has a herd gathered beyond it but lost most of his horses to Mexican raiders.

places.name: Sabinas
places.note: Dish falsely tells Chick the brothel is there, across the river, to keep him away from Lorena.
places.location_hint: in Mexico, described by Dish as about a day's ride southeast after crossing the Rio Grande from Lonesome Dove

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Jake says the Dry Bean's whiskey beats Arkansas liquor; Xavier sneers at the place.

places.name: Matagorda
places.note: Dish considers riding back there and abandoning the outfit.
places.location_hint: Texas Gulf Coast around Matagorda Bay

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: resting at the outfit's barn before a night trip into Mexico

groups.label: Wilbarger's party
groups.hint: at the Hat Creek house asking to buy horses; their herd waits beyond the Nueces

groups.label: Dry Bean saloon
groups.hint: drinking at the Dry Bean saloon
